scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && apps\api\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m mypy apps\api\src
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.db:migrate: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Push-Location apps/api; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m alembic -c alembic.ini upgrade head; Pop-Location"
